description: Table 1 is a text-only table (no axes, curves or images) summarising the matrix phases and precipitates observed in two duplex low-density steels as a function of annealing temperature. Rows are grouped by alloy — Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.5C-5Ni (upper block) and the Ni-free Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.5C (lower block) — each subdivided into "Matrix Phase" and "Precipitates"; the leftmost column header is "Alloy". Columns give four annealing temperatures, 500 °C, 700 °C, 900 °C and 1050 °C, the latter three split into paired sub-columns for the γ and α phases. For the 5Ni alloy the matrix is γ at 500 and 700 °C and γ + α at 900 and 1050 °C; precipitates are cuboidal κ (< 100 nm) marked (●), coarse B2 particles (2–7 μm) marked (◆) and B2 stringer bands marked (♣) at 500–700 °C, becoming coarse B2 particles (2–7 μm) in the matrix plus disc-like B2 (≈200 nm) at 900 °C and coarse B2 particles (2–4 μm) plus disc-like B2 at 1050 °C. The Ni-free alloy is γ + α at all four temperatures, always containing coarse B2 particles (2–4 μm), needle-like κ (width 200 ± 33 nm at 500 °C, 500 ± 33 nm at 700 °C) and, from 900 °C, disc-like B2 (≈200 nm). The symbols ●, ◆, ♣ and ♠ correspond to the precipitate types indicated in the accompanying micrographs.

subfigures.description: Single-panel text table with two alloy row blocks (Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.5C-5Ni and Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.5C), each split into 'Matrix Phase' and 'Precipitates', across four annealing temperatures (500, 700, 900, 1050 °C) with γ/α sub-columns; entries list κ-carbide and B2 precipitate morphologies with sizes and marker symbols.

observations.observation: Table 1 tabulates the matrix phase(s) and precipitate types at 500 °C, 700 °C, 900 °C and 1050 °C for two alloys labelled Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.5C-5Ni and Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.5C.
In Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.5C-5Ni the matrix phase is γ alone at 500 °C and 700 °C, and γ + α at 900 °C and 1050 °C.
At 500 °C and 700 °C the 5Ni alloy contains cuboidal κ (< 100 nm) marked (●), coarse B2 particles (2–7 μm) marked (◆) and B2 stringer bands marked (♣).
At 900 °C the 5Ni alloy lists coarse B2 particles (2–7 μm) in the matrix plus disc-like B2 (≈200 nm), both marked (◆), and no κ-carbide.

At 1050 °C the 5Ni alloy lists coarse B2 particles (2–4 μm) and disc-like B2 marked (◆); the printed size for disc-like B2 in the 1050 °C column reads ≈200 μm, which conflicts with the ≈200 nm given for disc-like B2 at 900 °C and with the caption's text.
In Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.5C the matrix phase is γ + α at all four annealing temperatures (500, 700, 900 and 1050 °C).
The Ni-free alloy contains needle-like κ of width 200 ± 33 nm at 500 °C and 500 ± 33 nm at 700 °C, marked (♠).
The Ni-free alloy contains coarse B2 particles (2–4 μm) marked (◆) at every annealing temperature, and disc-like B2 (≈200 nm) at 900 °C and 1050 °C.
The table caption states that the samples compared are 5 wt.% Ni and Ni-free compositions.
The caption states that all ordered structures observed in the microstructures of the steels are summarised in this table.
The citing text states that κ-carbides formed nano-sized blocks in austenite in both Ni-containing and Ni-free samples and as micron-sized needles within ferrite only in the Ni-free sample.
The citing text states that B2 discs were of Ni-Al type in the Ni-containing samples but of Fe-Al type in the Ni-free samples.
The citing text asserts that at 500–700 °C the ferrite phase in the 5% Ni sample was replaced by B2 stringer bands.
The table and its caption label the carbon content as 0.5C (Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.5C-5Ni / Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.5C), whereas the paper abstract names Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.8C-5Ni and Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.8C (wt.%).

unreadable_items: Internal inconsistency as printed: disc-like B2 in the 1050 °C columns is written ≈200 μm in the table while the caption/900 °C value is ≈200 nm; cannot determine from the image which unit is correct
Composition discrepancy between the table/caption (0.5C) and the abstract (0.8C) cannot be resolved from the figure alone
